name: DLGM #458 vs Fusion #879: one combined index
author: claude-fable52 (fable52-asi-fusion-20261112), for Scott
frozen_note: Weights, scoring rule and constants fixed while Fusion seed 1 was in its first minutes on the GPU queue and before the author had read any Fusion result under this objective.

components.title: Your objective, same number of training steps
components.measure: Held-out loss after 1,200 steps in the AGILLM-objective simulator (0.6 AR + 0.2 SAT + 0.2 NAT), gain over the live block. Faithful form, all complete seeds.

components.title: Your objective, long context
components.measure: What 4x more context does to the loss (1,024 tokens against 256) at step 1,200, relative to the live block. Faithful form.

components.title: Your objective, same simulator box time
components.measure: The site's equal-time method (step cost = 0.75 x bytes streamed + 0.25 x measured ms per step, against the base run of the same day), gain over the live block. Low-rank form, the one that fits at full scale.

components.title: Your matched small-model run (v65 R6)
components.measure: Held-out cross-entropy gain over the width-96 Transformer at an equal 120 training-CPU-seconds, about 350k parameters, 3 paired seeds; WikiText and FineWeb scored separately and averaged.

components.title: ASI-Arch paper: benchmark tasks
components.measure: 7-task average, gain over the Gated DeltaNet baseline; the 20M and 340M runs scored separately and averaged. Single runs.

components.title: ASI-Arch paper: training loss
components.measure: Final training loss, gain over the Gated DeltaNet baseline; the 20M and 340M runs scored separately and averaged. Single runs.

components.title: Serving readiness
components.measure: Rubric: 100 = an exact incremental cache verified against full recompute on trained checkpoints; 50 = a cache that reproduces the same tokens but failed the exact-match gate; 0 = none.

scoring: For a gain component each candidate scores 100 x max(gain, 0) / max(gain of DLGM, gain of Fusion, floor). The better one gets 100 when its gain clears the noise floor, the other gets its share of that gain, and a candidate that does not beat the shared baseline gets 0. Where a component has sub-experiments they are scored separately and averaged. Index = weighted sum of the component scores (0 to 100).
headline_rule: The name on top is the higher index. A margin under 3 points is called level in words.

robustness.method: weights drawn uniformly from the simplex over the available components; also every leave-one-component-out index

not_scored: Footprint and arithmetic at 560 layers (reported: the two are equal to well under 1%)

v65_r6.source: SG memory slot 2342 (ChatGPT lane, 2026-11-09), natural-log cross-entropy per byte

upstream.source: ASI-Arch paper (arXiv 2507.18074v2) Table 9 and data/106.json at commit 3113c51b
upstream.note_1p3b: At 1.3B parameters only Fusion was trained upstream: 52.01 on 14 accuracy metrics against 51.04 for DeltaNet.

serving.dlgm_reason: Incremental cache attempts v63 and v64 reproduced the same tokens (RMS error about 1e-6) but failed the strict exact-match gate twice; the Transformer baseline failed the same gate.
serving.fusion_reason: Exact incremental cache verified against full recompute on three trained checkpoints (worst error 1.3e-14 in float64, 1.0e-5 in float32); fixed state of 103,680 bytes; public at experiments/asi_arch_psfr_cache_v1.
